title: Birthday
statementMd:
Anon and Soyo are good friends. To celebrate Anon's birthday, Soyo decides to buy a cake. After careful selection, she chooses a round strawberry cake to share with Anon at home.

The cake is modeled as a circle centered at the origin $(0, 0)$ with radius $r$. There are $n$ strawberries on the cake, where the $i$-th strawberry is located at $(x_i, y_i)$. The distance of any strawberry from the origin is at most $0.9r$.

Soyo wants to cut the cake into two pieces with a single straight line. Since Anon loves strawberries, Soyo wants Anon's piece contains all of them. If a strawberry lies on the cutting line, Soyo can assign it to either piece.

Soyo wants to make the smaller piece as large as possible. Please help Soyo determine the maximum possible area of the smaller piece, given that all strawberries lie on the same piece.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $n$ and $r$, representing the number of strawberries on the cake and the radius of the cake, respectively.

The $i$-th of the following $n$ lines contains two integers $x_i$ and $y_i$, representing the coordinates of the $i$-th strawberry.

- $1 \leq n \leq 2 \times 10^5$
- $1 \leq r \leq 10^6$
- $\sqrt{{x_i}^2 + {y_i}^2} \leq 0.9r$
- All strawberries are at distinct points.

## Output

Print a single real number in one line, representing the maximum possible area of the smaller piece, given that all strawberries lie on the same piece.

Your answer will be accepted if the absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{-6}$. Formally, let your answer be $a$, and the jury's answer be $b$. Your answer is considered correct if ${\frac{\left\vert a - b \right\vert}{\max(1, \left\vert b \right\vert)} \leq 10^{-6}}$.
statementZhMd:
Anon 和 Soyo 是好朋友。为了庆祝 Anon 的生日，Soyo 决定买一个蛋糕。经过精心挑选，她选定了一款圆形草莓蛋糕，打算和 Anon 在家一起分享。

蛋糕被建模为一个以原点 $(0, 0)$ 为圆心、半径为 $r$ 的圆。蛋糕上有 $n$ 颗草莓，其中第 $i$ 颗草莓位于 $(x_i, y_i)$。任意草莓到原点的距离都不超过 $0.9r$。

Soyo 想用一条直线把蛋糕切成两块。由于 Anon 非常喜欢草莓，Soyo 希望 Anon 分到的那一块包含所有草莓。如果某颗草莓恰好落在切线上，Soyo 可以将它分给任意一块。

Soyo 想让较小的那一块尽可能大。请帮助 Soyo 求出：在所有草莓都位于同一块上的前提下，较小那一块面积的最大可能值。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $r$，分别表示蛋糕上草莓的数量和蛋糕的半径。

接下来 $n$ 行中的第 $i$ 行包含两个整数 $x_i$ 和 $y_i$，表示第 $i$ 颗草莓的坐标。

- $1 \leq n \leq 2 \times 10^5$
- $1 \leq r \leq 10^6$
- $\sqrt{{x_i}^2 + {y_i}^2} \leq 0.9r$
- 所有草莓的位置互不相同。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出一个实数，表示在所有草莓都位于同一块上的前提下，较小那一块面积的最大可能值。

当你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{-6}$ 时，该答案将被判定为正确。形式化地，设你的答案为 $a$，评测方的答案为 $b$。若 ${\frac{\left\vert a - b \right\vert}{\max(1, \left\vert b \right\vert)} \leq 10^{-6}}$，则你的答案被视为正确。
